compound object including the original liṅga and related items
fused form: arcayet (optative of √arc) + arcana-ukta-vat (comparative adverbial compound)

items.question: What ritual procedure must follow installing the root liṅga when the original remains unfound?
premises: The root liṅga and related items have been installed.
Prescribed worship procedures already exist in the ritual texts.
Worship must conform to those established prescriptions.
items.inference: After installing the root liṅga and related items, one should perform worship according to the prescribed manner.
items.plain_english: Having installed the root liṅga and so forth, one should worship it in the manner prescribed for worship.
